arxiv-2110-15795.title: Statistical Review of Animal Trials - A Guideline Publication type: Article Type
arxiv-2110-15795.creator: Sophie K. Piper*, Dario Zocholl, Ulf Toelch, Robert Roehle, Andrea Stroux, Johanna Hößler, Anne Zinke, Frank Konietschke
arxiv-2110-15795.description: Abstract Any experiment involving living organisms requires justification of the need and moral defensibleness of the study. Statistical planning, design and sample size calculation of the experiment are no less important review criteria than general medical and ethical points to consider. Errors made in the statistical planning and data evaluation phase can have severe consequences on both results and conclusions.

arxiv-2211-13001.creator: Dohyun Kim, Hansol Park, Woojoo Shim
arxiv-2211-13001.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Dohyun Kim, Hansol Park, Woojoo Shim. We introduce a higher simplicial generalization of the linear consensus model which shares several common features. The well-known linear consensus model is a gradient flow with a sum of squares of distances between each pair of points. Our newly suggested model is also represented as a gradient flow equipped with total n n -dimensional volume functional consisting of n + 1 n+1 points as a potential.

arxiv-2402-04560.title: Large Eddy Simulation of the evolution of the soot size distribution in turbulent nonpremixed bluff body flames
arxiv-2402-04560.creator: Hernando Maldonado Colmán, Michael E. Mueller, [10pt] Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, Princeton University, Princeton, NJ 08544, USA [-5pt]
arxiv-2402-04560.description: Abstract Large Eddy Simulation (LES) was used to investigate the evolution of the soot size distribution in a series of turbulent nonpremixed bluff body flames, with different bluff body diameters. The new Bivariate Multi-Moment Sectional Method (BMMSM) is employed to characterize the size distribution.

arxiv-2403-14520.title: Cobra: Extending Mamba to Multi-Modal Large Language Model for Efficient Inference
arxiv-2403-14520.creator: Han Zhao, Min Zhang, Wei Zhao, Pengxiang Ding, Siteng Huang, Donglin Wang
arxiv-2403-14520.description: Abstract In recent years, applying multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) in various fields has achieved remarkable success. However, as the foundation model for many downstream tasks, MLLMs comprise the well-known Transformer network, which has a less efficient quadratic computation complexity.

arxiv-2406-03569.title: GFN: A graph feedforward network for resolution-invariant reduced operator learning in multifidelity applications
arxiv-2406-03569.creator: Oisín M. Morrison 1 ID , Federico Pichi 1,2 ID , and Jan S. Hesthaven 1 ID
arxiv-2406-03569.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Oisín M. Morrison 1 ID , Federico Pichi 1,2 ID , and Jan S. Hesthaven 1 ID. This work presents a novel resolution-invariant model order reduction strategy for multifidelity applications. We base our architecture on a novel neural network layer developed in this work, the graph feedforward network, which extends the concept of feedforward networks to graph-structured data by creating a direct link between the weights of a neural network and the nodes of a mesh, enhancing the interpretability of the network.

arxiv-2411-05268.title: KMT-2024-BLG-1044L: A sub-Uranus microlensing planet around a host at the star–brown dwarf mass boundary
arxiv-2411-05268.creator: Cheongho Han, Yoon-Hyun Ryu, Chung-Uk Lee, Andrew Gould, Michael D. Albrow, Sun-Ju Chung, Kyu-Ha Hwang, Youn Kil Jung, Yossi Shvartzvald, In-Gu Shin, Jennifer C. Yee, Hongjing Yang, Weicheng Zang, Doeon Kim, Dong-Jin Kim, Byeong-Gon Park, Richard W. Pogge (The KMTNet Collaboration)
arxiv-2411-05268.description: Abstract Aims. We analysed microlensing data to uncover the nature of the anomaly that appeared near the peak of the short-timescale microlensing event KMT-2024-BLG-1044. Despite the anomaly’s brief duration of less than a day, it was densely observed through high-cadence monitoring conducted by the KMTNet survey. Methods.

arxiv-2411-15122.title: ReXrank: A Public Leaderboard for AI-Powered Radiology Report Generation
arxiv-2411-15122.creator: Xiaoman Zhang, Hong-Yu Zhou, Xiaoli Yang, Oishi Banerjee, Julián N. Acosta, Mohammed Baharoon, Josh Miller, Ouwen Huang, Pranav Rajpurkar
arxiv-2411-15122.description: Abstract AI-driven models have demonstrated significant potential in automating radiology report generation for chest X-rays. However, there is no standardized benchmark for objectively evaluating their performance. To address this, we present ReXrank ( https://rexrank.ai ), a public leaderboard and challenge for assessing AI-powered radiology report generation.

arxiv-2505-03686.title: The response of a quantum system to a collision: an autonomous derivation of Kubo’s formula
arxiv-2505-03686.creator: Samuel L. Jacob, John Goold
arxiv-2505-03686.description: Abstract We study the response of a quantum system induced by a collision with a quantum particle, using the time-independent framework of scattering theory. After deriving the dynamical map for the quantum system, we show that it encodes a non-perturbative response function obeying a general fluctuation-dissipation relation.

arxiv-2506-03322.title: Dynamical mass of the Serpens intermediate-mass young stellar system EC 95 with DYNAMO–VLBA
arxiv-2506-03322.creator: Jazmín Ordóñez-Toro , Sergio A. Dzib , Laurent Loinard , Gisela Ortiz-León , Marina A. Kounkel , Phillip A. B. Galli , Josep M. Masqué , Luis H. Quiroga-Nuñez , Sundar Srinivasan , S.-N. X. Medina , Luis F. Rodríguez ,
arxiv-2506-03322.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jazmín Ordóñez-Toro , Sergio A. Dzib , Laurent Loinard , Gisela Ortiz-León , Marina A. Kounkel , Phillip A. B. Galli , Josep M. Masqué , Luis H. Quiroga-Nuñez , Sundar Srinivasan , S.-N. X. Medina , Luis F. Rodríguez ,. We present dynamical mass measurements, obtained from multi-epoch Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI) observations, for the young multiple stellar system EC 95, located in the core of the Serpens star-forming region.

arxiv-2507-07222.title: Efficient Parametric SVD of Koopman Operator for Stochastic Dynamical Systems
arxiv-2507-07222.creator: Minchan Jeong, J. Jon Ryu, Se-Young Yun, Gregory W. Wornell
arxiv-2507-07222.description: Abstract The Koopman operator provides a principled framework for analyzing nonlinear dynamical systems through linear operator theory. Recent advances in dynamic mode decomposition (DMD) have shown that trajectory data can be used to identify dominant modes of a system in a data-driven manner.

arxiv-2508-18236.title: Interpretable Evaluation of AI-Generated Content with Language-Grounded Sparse Encoders
arxiv-2508-18236.creator: Yiming Tang, Arash Lagzian, Srinivas Anumasa, Qiran Zou, Trang Nguyen, Ehsan Adeli, Ching-Yu Cheng, Yilun Du, Dianbo Liu †
arxiv-2508-18236.description: Abstract While the quality of AI-generated contents, such as synthetic images, has become remarkably high, current evaluation metrics provide only coarse-grained assessments, failing to identify specific strengths and weaknesses that researchers and practitioners need for model selection and development, further limiting the scientific understanding and commercial deployment of these generative models.

arxiv-2602-09411.title: K-Sort Eval: Efficient Preference Evaluation for Visual Generation via Corrected VLM-as-a-Judge
arxiv-2602-09411.creator: Zhikai Li, Jiatong Li, Xuewen Liu, Wangbo Zhao, Pan Du, Kaicheng Zhou, Qingyi Gu, Yang You, Zhen Dong, Kurt Keutzer
arxiv-2602-09411.description: Abstract The rapid development of visual generative models raises the need for more scalable and human-aligned evaluation methods. While the crowdsourced Arena platforms offer human preference assessments by collecting human votes, they are costly and time-consuming, inherently limiting their scalability. Leveraging vision-language model (VLMs) as substitutes for manual judgments presents a promising solution.

govdocs-archive_org-untitled-document-1.creator: Unknown
govdocs-archive_org-untitled-document-1.description: A personal timeline recounting alleged targeting and harassment of Belinda Sue Winchester from 1979 onward. It closes with an AI assistant's offer to reformat it, indicating AI-generated text; it is not a declassified government document.

pmc-10553811.title: Measuring uncertainty in human visual segmentation
pmc-10553811.creator: Jonathan Vacher, Claire Launay, Pascal Mamassian, Ruben Coen-Cagli, Daniele Marinazzo, Emma Claire Robinson, Daniele Marinazzo, Emma Claire Robinson, Daniele Marinazzo, Emma Claire Robinson, Daniele Marinazzo, Emma Claire Robinson
pmc-10553811.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Segmenting visual stimuli into distinct groups of features and visual objects is central to visual function. Classical psychophysical methods have helped uncover many rules of human perceptual segmentation, and recent progress in machine learning has produced successful algorithms. Yet, the computational logic of human segmentation remains unclear, partially because we lack well-controlled paradigms to measure perceptual segmentation maps and compare models quantitatively.

pmc-11450250.title: Greater impact of COVID‐19 on peer‐supported addiction services than government‐owned services for addiction in Japan: A nationwide 3‐year longitudinal cohort study
pmc-11450250.creator: Munenori Katayama, Sou Fujishiro, Kanna Sugiura, Jun Konishi, Ken Inada, Norihito Shirakawa, Toshihiko Matsumoto
pmc-11450250.description: AimThis study aims to investigate how the coronavirus disease (COVID‐19) pandemic impacted service provision of peer‐supported addiction services, such as self‐help groups or recovery houses and government‐owned addiction healthcare services, in Japan, as well as the quality of their interaction.

pmc-12444937.title: Discovery and characterization of novel hematopoietic prostaglandin D synthase inhibitors from traditional Chinese medicine: the bioactive potential of dihydroberberine in treatments of Duchenne muscular dystrophy and inflammation-related diseases
pmc-12444937.creator: Cheng-Han Li, Min-Che Tung, Cheng-Kuan Tsai, Tz-Chuen Ju, Tien-Sheng Tseng
pmc-12444937.description: Inflammation plays a central role in various diseases, necessitating effective anti-inflammatory agents. Prostaglandin D2 (PGD2), a key mediator synthesised by haematopoietic prostaglandin D synthase (H-PGDS), is linked to allergic and inflammatory conditions. This study employed pharmacophore-based screening to identify inhibitors targeting H-PGDS. The model Phar-A2HR2 identified EMy (IC50 = 88.9 ± 1.1 µM) as a potential inhibitor.

pmc-12534515.title: Factors associated with willingness to use ecological sanitation toilets in Katine sub county Soroti district Uganda: a cross sectional study
pmc-12534515.creator: Betty Osako Ikiring, David Okia, Charles Okolimong, Jimmy Patrick Alunyo, Richard Katuramu, Annet Tabitha Khainza, David Mukunya, Joseph K B Matovu, David Musoke, Peter Olupot-Olupot, Benon Wanume
pmc-12534515.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Ecological sanitation (EcoSan) toilets provide a sustainable approach to waste management by converting human excreta into usable agricultural inputs. Despite their environmental and health benefits, uptake remains low in many settings. This study investigated the proportion of community members in Katine sub-county, Soroti district, Eastern Uganda, who had ever used EcoSan toilets, their willingness to use them, and the factors associated with this willingness. A cross-sectional survey was conducted among 395 residents using structured questionnaires.

pmc-12987522.creator: Unknown

pmc-13085261.title: Effect of immune-related lncRNA BZRAP1-AS1/miR-541-3p and its molecular mechanism in cervical cancer
pmc-13085261.creator: Zhixiang Zou, Lina Huang, Ke Yin, Yi Li, Mengying Tang, Chao He
pmc-13085261.description: BackgroundCervical cancer (CC) remains a significant health concern for women worldwide, with poor prognosis often linked to late diagnosis. This study aimed to explore the clinical significance and molecular mechanisms of long non-coding RNA BZRAP1-AS1.MethodsA total of 105 CC patients were enrolled, and paired tumor and normal tissues were collected.

pmc-13179470.title: A Propionate Metabolism‐Based Gene Signature Reveals Immunogenomic and Transcriptomic Determinants of Prognosis in Glioblastoma Through Multiomics Integration
pmc-13179470.creator: Mengtong Li, Jiayi Liu, Zichen Liu, Xia Liu, Peng Lun
pmc-13179470.description: Glioblastoma (GBM) remains a lethal brain tumor with limited prognostic tools. Metabolic reprogramming, particularly in understudied pathways like propionate metabolism, may offer new biomarkers. Here, we identified a novel prognostic signature based on seven propionate metabolism‐related genes (SLC9A1, ELANE, ACADS, SOAT2, MYD88, ADSL, and BMP2) from the TCGA‐GBM cohort.

pmc-13327105.title: Rupture of a caseous calcified amorphous tumour on mitral annular calcification: serial transoesophageal echocardiographic documentation
pmc-13327105.creator: Haruka Harata, Takeshi Maruo, Tatsuhiko Komiya, Mitsuru Abe, Roman Komorovsky, Nelya Oryshchyn, Erick Alexanderson Rosas

pmc-13410722.title: Characterization of Three Complete Mitochondrial Genomes of Hemiculter and Comparative Mitogenomic Analysis of Cultrinae Fishes
pmc-13410722.creator: Seung Hyun Lee, Sang Ki Kim, Seung Woo Jang, Kyong In Suh, Jong Kyun Park, Kang-Rae Kim
pmc-13410722.description: The genus Hemiculter includes closely related freshwater fishes widely distributed across East Asia, and several species are difficult to distinguish using external morphology alone. Mitochondrial markers have been widely used for species identification and phylogenetic inference in fishes, but single-gene approaches may be insufficient when nominal species show recent divergence, mitochondrial introgression, or taxonomic inconsistency.

pmc-13430203.title: SCLC humanized mice identify T cell infiltration phenotypes in response to combination immune-radiation therapies
pmc-13430203.creator: Bell Xi Wu, Xiaozhuo Ran, Olivia Huang, Lifang Song, Vivek Philip, Adrian Sacher, Ming-Sound Tsao, Benjamin H Lok

pmc-13577704.title: Genomic characterization and phylogenetic placement of Matryoshka RNA virus 1 associated with Plasmodium vivax malaria in Africa
pmc-13577704.creator: Frank Chilombolwa Nyondo
pmc-13577704.description: Plasmodium vivax is a major cause of human malaria. It harbours Matryoshka RNA virus 1 (MaRNAV-1), a bi-segmented positive-sense RNA virus. MaRNAV-1 was first described in P. vivax and is now recognized as part of a wider group of Matryoshka viruses. These viruses also infect other haemosporidian parasites such as Leucocytozoon and Haemoproteus.

pmc-13650360.title: Effect of abatacept on bone in patients with psoriatic arthritis—results from a prospective interventional high-resolution imaging study (ABEPSA)
pmc-13650360.creator: Alp Temiz, Melek Yalcin-Mutlu, Giulia Corte, Sara Bayat, Louis Schuster, David Simon, Jürgen Rech, Dagmar Werner, Koray Tascilar, Filippo Fagni, Frank Roemer, Georg Schett, Arnd Kleyer
pmc-13650360.description: ObjectivesAbatacept (ABA) is a selective costimulation modulator that inhibits T cell activation. It is approved for rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and psoriatic arthritis (PsA). While its efficacy in RA is well established, its effect on structural joint damage in PsA remains uncertain.
